datasets.title: Gas and mass of MACS J0025
datasets.description: The 2008 composite of MACS J0025.4-1222 in its layers: Chandra's X-ray image of the hot gas in pink and the mass map from gravitational lensing in blue. Each is drawn as a body round the line through the two mass peaks of Bradač et al. (2008): a symmetry the paper's head-on collision implies, not a measured depth. The Hubble picture, with its stars and galaxies removed, stands flat at the cluster's distance.
datasets.summary: Pink is X-ray gas and blue is the lensing mass map, each drawn round the line of the collision. Their depth is not measured.

facts.label: Colors
facts.value: Pink: hot gas in X-rays (Chandra). Blue: mass from gravitational lensing (Hubble)
